name: Blanes
label: Blanes
view: From S'Abanell beach looking north-east: Sa Palomera, the rock that marks the start of the Costa Brava, with the Portal de la Costa Brava arch on its sandy isthmus; behind it the old town with the Gothic bell tower of Santa Maria and the Turo de Sant Joan rising to the Castell de Sant Joan keep and hermitage; the Mediterranean in front with a sea glint, the S'Abanell promenade (umbrella pines, palms, apartment blocks) on the left. Heights to scale per layer as for a viewer about 460 m from the rock (rock 1.4 dp/m, town 0.65 dp/m, hill 0.40 dp/m); hill outline from an EU-DEM panorama, horizontal spacing compressed to fit the hero zone. The port breakwater and the Marimurtra cliffs (cypresses, Templet de Linne) lie further right, behind the rain column.
landmarks: Sa Palomera (20.8 m, with its flagpole)
Portal de la Costa Brava (Antoni Rossello, 2002, ~9 m)
Castell de Sant Joan keep (~15 m, 7.25 m diameter) on the Turo de Sant Joan (172 m)

Jardi Botanic Marimurtra cliffs and Templet de Linne (behind the rain column)
